check_description: Re-derive the total library size from the heat-map grid dimensions and compare with the count stated in the text.
what_it_would_catch: A wrong tail set, a wrong amine set, or a library assigned the wrong amine series (a1-a16 vs b1-b13).
method: Counted rows and columns of each of the six populated blocks in MOESM3 sheet Fig1 independently of the figure images, then summed.
expected: 310 crude lipid compounds (stated in Results).
note: Also confirms that the phenol and thiol libraries use amines a1-a16 while the ketone, pyrrole and acetophenone libraries use b1-b13.

check_description: Re-derive the degree of substitution from three independent sources rather than from the generic scheme alone.
what_it_would_catch: A systematic error across every member of every library: one arm per amine instead of two, or substitution of secondary and amide N-H.
method: (a) generic scheme Supplementary Fig. 1; (b) assembled structures counted arm-by-arm in Supplementary Figs. 2-3 and 5-6; (c) Methods scale-up stoichiometry for C-a16; (d) C-a16 1H NMR integrations re-assigned from scratch.
expected: If 2 arms per primary NH2: A-a6 4 arms, A-a13/A-a14 6 arms, A-a12/A-a15/A-a16 4 arms with intact internal N-H; C-a16 phenol:HCHO:amine near 4:4:1; C-a16 N-CH2-Ar = 8H, 12 ArH, 12 H of terminal CH3, 40 H of (CH2)5.
observed: A-a6 4 arms; A-a13 and A-a14 6 arms; A-a12, A-a15, E-a12 and A-a16 4 arms with the internal secondary or amide N-H drawn explicitly intact; Methods 4.5 : 4.2 : 1.0; NMR 3.86-3.43 m 8H, 6.99-6.82 m 8H + 6.72-6.67 t 4H = 12 ArH, 0.90 t 12H, 1.29 d 40H.
note: Four independent lines agree. Degree of substitution = 2 x (number of primary NH2); secondary amine and amide N-H do not react.

check_description: Re-derive the phenolic tail chain lengths a second time, without reference to the first reading.
what_it_would_catch: An off-by-one or off-by-two carbon error propagated across 16 lipids per tail.
method: Pass 1: counted alternating near-horizontal and near-vertical bonds in a 600 dpi render. Pass 2: measured terminal-vertex y coordinates from the ink profile and converted using the per-two-carbon drop calibrated on tail C, which Methods name p-octylphenol.
expected: Tail C = 8 carbons from both passes; B and D expressed as integer offsets from C.
observed: Pass 1: B 3 treads + 3 steeps = 6; C 4+4 = 8; D 5 treads + 4 steeps = 9. Pass 2: termini at 331, 398 and 416 px; C-B = 67 px = one two-carbon unit (70 px), D-C = 18 px = one single-bond tread. Both passes give B 6, C 8, D 9.
note: Tail C independently anchored by the Methods name p-octylphenol and by the Results phrase '8-carbon alkyl group'.

check_description: Test the regiochemistry of phenol aminomethylation rather than assuming it.
what_it_would_catch: An arm placed on the wrong ring carbon. Molecular formula and HRMS are blind to this, so only a drawn product or a described route can settle it.
method: Read the drawn Mannich product in Supplementary Fig. 1 and, separately, the assembled tail-A lipid A-a1 in Supplementary Fig. 2a; checked the ring positions of OH, CH2N and R1 against each other.
expected: Either ortho or para to OH, with the alkyl para to OH in tails B/C/D.
observed: In both drawings OH and CH2N occupy adjacent ring carbons and R1 is para to OH, i.e. aminomethylation ortho to OH with the para position blocked by the alkyl in B/C/D. Tail A is also drawn ortho even though its para position is free.
note: Pinned for B, C and D because para is blocked. For tail A the ortho placement is drawn but not chemically forced and no text statement supports it; recorded in the T_A ambiguity note rather than treated as settled.

check_description: Test whether the trailing digit in the heat-map tail tokens I1/J1/K1/L1 and I2/J2/K2/L2 encodes chain length or a second tail.
what_it_would_catch: A duplicated or invented set of four tails, and a doubling of the apparent block count.
method: Compared the four diesters drawn in Supplementary Fig. 7b against those in Supplementary Fig. 10b, counting the ester-arm carbons in each figure separately.
expected: If the digit encoded a tail property, the two figures would draw different structures.
observed: Both figures draw the identical four diesters: diethyl, dibutyl, dihexyl and dioctyl 1,3-acetonedicarboxylate. The figures differ only in the ketone:formaldehyde:amine ratio, 1:2:1 vs 1:4:2.
note: The trailing digit is a library index. Recorded explicitly in the naming_rule of COND_03 and COND_04.

check_description: Test the naive reading of the phrase 'dialkyl ketone' against the drawn reagent.
what_it_would_catch: Four completely wrong tail structures and a wrong reaction product for 104 of the 310 lipids.
method: Read the structures in Supplementary Figs. 7b and 10b and the products in Supplementary Figs. 7a, 10a and 1.
expected: A simple dialkyl ketone R-CO-R if the text were taken at face value.
observed: The reagents are 1,3-acetonedicarboxylate (3-oxoglutarate) diesters, R'O2C-CH2-CO-CH2-CO2R'. The products are a 4-oxopiperidine-3,5-dicarboxylate at 1:2:1 and a 3,7-diazabicyclo[3.3.1]nonan-9-one bispidinone at 1:4:2.
note: The naive reading is wrong. CSV 1 block_class is tail with reactive_site_type active_methylene, and the correct diester SMILES are emitted. The text also calls these same reagents 'carboxylic acid derivatives' in the b10 sentence, which is the more accurate description.

check_description: Cross-validate the small b-series amine drawings against the much larger a-series drawings in Fig. 1c.
what_it_would_catch: Misread methylene counts in the small, low-resolution Supplementary Fig. 7c / 10c / 13c / 15c panels.
method: Looked for structures that appear in both series and compared them independently.
expected: The Results state that a2 and b10 are the same reagent, N,N-diethylethylenediamine. If the small drawings are being read correctly, further identities should also hold.
observed: a1 = b8 (N,N-dimethyl-1,3-propanediamine), a2 = b10, a4 = b5 (2-piperidin-1-yl-ethanamine), a5 = b6 (3-(4-methylpiperazin-1-yl)propan-1-amine). Four independent matches.
note: Gives independent support for the methylene counts read from the small panels, including the two- vs three-carbon distinctions in b5/b6 and b10/b11.

check_description: Adversarially re-read b3 and b4, which look like plausible-but-wrong transcriptions of common reagents.
what_it_would_catch: Either an invented extra methylene (if the paper really drew one) or a silently corrected drawing error (if I had assumed the common reagent).
method: Rendered b3 and b4 at 600 dpi from each of the four figures that show them and counted bonds between the primary N and the tertiary N; compared with b5, b6 and b9 in the same panels, which are known to be 2, 3 and 2 methylenes.
expected: Two methylenes if the reagents are the commercially available N,N-dimethylethylenediamine and 1-(2-aminoethyl)-4-methylpiperazine.
observed: Exactly one methylene in every rendering of b3 and b4, in all four figures. The same panels render one, two and three methylenes distinguishably. As drawn, both are aminals, which are not isolable reagents; and the two-carbon homologue of b3 already appears separately as b9.
note: Emitted exactly as drawn with read_confidence low and an explicit note. The paper names neither reagent anywhere, so the intended structures cannot be recovered from the paper and were not guessed.

check_description: Check the per-tail hit counts in the Results against the hit list actually plotted.
what_it_would_catch: A wrong set of lipids carried into the in vivo condition rows.
method: Counted the 11 named lipids in the Fig. 1k-p panels and, independently, in the MOESM3 source-data header row for the Fig.1m and Fig.1p blocks.
expected: Results state phenol A 0, B 3, C 6, D 2 hits, totalling 11.
observed: The plotted list is B-a11, B-a16, C-a9, C-a10, C-a11, C-a12, C-a15, C-a16, D-a9, D-a11, D-a16, i.e. A 0, B 2, C 6, D 3.
note: The B and D counts are transposed between text and figure. Both readings total 11, so the in vivo block_ids are unaffected; recorded in the COND_07 and COND_08 ambiguity notes.

check_description: Check the LNP molar ratio in the Methods against the ratio tabulated in Fig. 2c.
what_it_would_catch: A wrong formulation recorded for every C-a16 experiment downstream of the screen.
method: Read the Methods 'Preparation of LNPs' paragraph and the Fig. 2c table separately and in full.
expected: A single consistent ratio.
observed: Methods: ionizable lipid/DOPE/cholesterol/DMG-PEG = 50/10/38.5/1.5 for all LNPs other than DLin-MC3-DMA. Fig. 2c: C-a16/DOPE/Chol/DMG-PEG = 35:16:46.5:2.5.
note: Both readings recorded verbatim; COND_09 marked inconclusive. The screening rows retain the Methods ratio because the screen predates the Fig. 2 characterization.

check_description: Check the cargo nucleoside modification stated in the Results against the Methods.
what_it_would_catch: A wrong cargo identity on every condition row.
method: Read the Results LNP-preparation sentence and the Methods 'Synthesis of mRNAs' paragraph separately.
expected: A single consistent modified nucleoside.
observed: Results: luciferase mRNA described as 5-methoxyuridine-modified. Methods: all mRNAs transcribed in the presence of 1-methylpseudouridine-modified nucleoside.
note: Both readings recorded in cargo_identity on every row rather than silently choosing one.

check_description: Check the intramuscular imaging timepoint in the Results against the Supplementary Fig. 18 caption.
what_it_would_catch: A wrong timepoint on the intramuscular condition row.
method: Read the Results paragraph and the Supplementary Fig. 18 caption separately.
expected: A single consistent timepoint.
observed: Results: 6 h post-injection. Supplementary Fig. 18: 24 h.
note: timepoint_h left literally empty in COND_08 and both readings recorded in the note; the row is marked inconclusive.

check_description: Check the identity of the benchmark lipid in Fig. 1p against the source-data file.
what_it_would_catch: A wrong comparator recorded for the intramuscular screen.
method: Read the printed Fig. 1p x-axis labels from a 600 dpi render and, separately, the MOESM3 sheet Fig1 header row for the Fig.1p block.
expected: The same benchmark in both.
observed: Printed axis: DLin-MC3-DMA. Source data header: SM-102. The Fig.1m block agrees with its printed axis (DLin-MC3-DMA) in both places.
note: Recorded in the COND_08 note; the discrepancy affects only the comparator, not the 11 library lipids.

check_description: Re-derive the thiol tail chain lengths a second time.
what_it_would_catch: An off-by-two carbon error across 16 lipids per tail.
method: Pass 1: counted zigzag vertices in a high-resolution render of Supplementary Fig. 4b. Pass 2: measured the terminal y coordinate of each of the four chains from the ink profile and converted using the per-carbon drop measured on tail E.
expected: A constant offset between consecutive tails if the series is regular.
observed: Pass 1: E = 6 carbons. Pass 2: termini at 1218, 1342, 1462 and 1583 px; differences 124, 120 and 121 px at 65 px per carbon, i.e. two carbons each. Both passes give 6, 8, 10 and 12.
note: No chain length is named anywhere for these tails, so read_confidence is med despite agreement.

check_description: Re-derive the acetophenone tail chain lengths a second time.
what_it_would_catch: An off-by-one or off-by-two carbon error across 13 lipids per tail.
method: Pass 1: direct visual vertex count. Pass 2: located the ring para-carbon from the collapse in ink width where the two ring edges meet, then divided the para-carbon-to-terminus drop by the per-carbon spacing.
expected: Integer carbon counts from both passes.
observed: Pass 1: Q 6, R 8. Pass 2: Q para-carbon 1085 px, terminus 1474 px, 389/65 = 5.98; R para-carbon 1126 px, terminus 1650 px, 524/65.5 = 8.0. Both passes agree.
note: An earlier reading that placed the Q para-carbon at the end of the inner double-bond line instead of at the ring vertex gave 7 carbons; the second pass caught and corrected it.

check_description: Re-derive the pyrrole tail O chain length.
what_it_would_catch: An off-by-two carbon error across 13 lipids.
method: Pass 1: visual vertex count from ring N to terminus. Pass 2: ring-N-to-terminus drop divided by the per-carbon spacing measured on the same chain.
expected: Integer carbon count from both passes.
observed: Pass 1: 8 carbons. Pass 2: 1130 px drop at 145 px per carbon = 7.8. Both give 8.
note: Chain length never named; read_confidence med.

check_description: Test whether the commercial reagents behind the drawn tails are defined single isomers or mixtures.
what_it_would_catch: A linear structure recorded for a reagent that is actually sold as a branched isomer mixture.
method: Checked whether the paper gives a CAS number, a vendor catalogue number or an isomeric descriptor for any tail; considered the normal commercial form of each drawn structure.
expected: Either a CAS or an explicit statement of isomeric purity for any reagent that is commonly sold as a mixture.
observed: The paper gives no CAS and no catalogue numbers for any synthesis reagent, only the collective supplier list Sigma-Aldrich / TCI Chemicals / Ambeed / ThermoFisher. Of the drawn tails, 4-nonylphenol (tail D) is the one normally sold as a technical branched positional-isomer mixture rather than the linear isomer drawn.
note: T_D read_confidence set to low with an explicit note. The remaining alkyl tails (hexyl, octyl, decyl, dodecyl) are routinely available as defined linear isomers, so they are left at med.

check_description: Determine the replicate number behind the six in vitro heat maps.
what_it_would_catch: A fabricated n for the screening rows.
method: Counted the values per lipid in each MOESM3 sheet Fig1 heat-map block and searched the Fig. 1 and Supplementary Fig. 17 captions for an n.
expected: Either a stated n or replicate rows in the source data.
observed: Each heat-map block holds exactly one value per lipid. n = 3 is stated only for Supplementary Fig. 17a,b,e,f and for Fig. 1m and 1p, not for the heat maps.
note: n_replicates and error_type left literally empty on COND_01 to COND_06.

check_description: Determine whether the pipette-mixed screening LNPs were purified before use.
what_it_would_catch: A purification step attributed to LNPs that may have been used crude.
method: Read the Methods 'Preparation of LNPs' paragraph in full and checked the order of the sentences.
expected: An explicit statement covering the screening LNPs.
observed: The dialysis and 0.22 um filtration sentence follows the microfluidic sentence and does not say which preparations it applies to.
note: dialysis_buffer is recorded on the screening rows with the ambiguity flagged in the note rather than being dropped or asserted.

check_description: Re-assign the C-a16 1H NMR from scratch against the proposed structure rather than reading it as confirmation.
what_it_would_catch: A wrong arm count or a wrong tail identity for the lead compound.
method: Predicted the integrations for four 2-hydroxy-5-octylbenzyl arms on 3,6-bis(4-aminobutyl)piperazine-2,5-dione, then compared with the reported spectrum.
expected: 12 aromatic H, 8 H for 4 x N-CH2-Ar, 12 H for 4 x terminal CH3, 40 H for 4 x (CH2)5.
note: Four independent integrations match, confirming both the octyl tail and the four-arm degree of substitution for the lead lipid.

check_description: Check whether the stereochemistry of amine a16 is pinned.
what_it_would_catch: A stereodescriptor asserted on a block the paper draws flat.
method: Inspected the a16 drawing in Fig. 1c and the assembled A-a16 in Supplementary Fig. 2 for wedge or hash bonds, and searched the text for a configuration.
expected: Wedges, a name such as cyclo(L-Lys-L-Lys), or a statement of the isomer used.
observed: No wedges in either drawing and no configuration stated anywhere. The diketopiperazine has two stereocentres.
note: SMILES emitted without stereodescriptors. The same applies to the single pyrrolidine stereocentre of a3.

check_description: Check whether the apparent pKa method is described.
what_it_would_catch: A pKa value recorded without a method, or a method invented for it.
method: Searched the Methods and the Fig. 2 caption for a TNS assay or any other pKa determination.
expected: A described assay.
observed: The value 6.38 appears only in the Fig. 2c table; no determination method is given anywhere.
note: apparent_pKa recorded on COND_09 with the gap noted.

check_description: Decide which experiments belong in the conditions table.
what_it_would_catch: Either an unbounded table of downstream immunology assays, or the silent omission of a distinct formulation.
method: Enumerated every experiment in the paper and separated those in which library members are evaluated from those in which only the single lead lipid C-a16 is used for a therapeutic or immunological endpoint.
expected: A bounded set of conditions covering every experiment in which the library is measured.
observed: Six in vitro library screens, one intravenous and one intramuscular in vivo screen of the 11 hits, plus the distinct C-a16 LNP formulation and its characterization: nine rows.
note: Downstream single-lipid experiments (Ttr gene editing, FGF21 supplementation, tumour neoantigen vaccination, SARS-CoV-2 spike vaccination, ROS and cytokine assays, RNA sequencing) are deliberately not enumerated as library conditions; they share the COND_09 C-a16 formulation and contribute no per-library-member data. Noted so the omission is visible rather than silent.

check_description: Check the paper against the project experiment manifest before extracting.
what_it_would_catch: Duplicating a paper already in the corpus.
method: Matched DOI 10.1038/s41551-025-01422-8 against the Publication_DOI column of experiment_manifest.csv (58 entries).
expected: No match if the paper is new.

check_description: Verify that every emitted SMILES parses and matches the intended molecular formula.
what_it_would_catch: A malformed SMILES or a transcription slip in a long chain.
method: Parsed all 54 emitted SMILES with RDKit and compared computed molecular formulae against the intended structures; for the four named commercial lipids, compared against their published formulae.
expected: All parse; DLin-MC3-DMA C43H79NO2, SM-102 C44H87NO5, ALC-0315 C48H95NO5, cholesterol C27H46O, DOPE C41H78NO8P, DSPC C44H88NO8P.
observed: All 54 parse. First-pass DLin-MC3-DMA and SM-102 SMILES returned C49H89NO4 and C40H79NO5 and were corrected to C43H79NO2 (642.11) and C44H87NO5 (710.18); all others matched on the first pass.
note: Two commercial-lipid SMILES were wrong in the draft and were caught only by the formula check, not by visual inspection.
